audience: small business owners and bookkeepers who do invoicing and accounting in sevdesk

useCases.title: See which invoices are still unpaid
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by status, date range or contact and opens one with totals and line items. You see which are open or partly paid.

useCases.title: Check bank balance and payments
useCases.text: The AI lists the payment accounts, reads the balance of one at a date, and lists bank transactions in a date range, for example payments that came in last month.

useCases.title: Review receipts and bills by status
useCases.text: The AI lists vouchers (receipts and bills) by status and by credit or debit, and opens one. You see what was recorded and what is unpaid.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and add contact details
useCases.text: The AI finds a contact, reads its email, phone and website entries, and adds a new email, phone or website to it.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft invoice
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice with line items for a contact. It is always saved as a draft, not sent, and you can edit it in sevdesk.
